title: Hide Ask AI About Your Notes Section

requirements.summary: Add a feature flag to conditionally hide the 'Ask AI About Your Notes' section in the dashboard without permanently removing the code
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Ask AI About Your Notes' section is not visible in the dashboard after summaries and quizzes are generated
The code for the Ask AI section remains in the codebase with a simple flag or boolean to control visibility
All other sections (quiz display, summaries, file upload) continue to function normally and are not affected by this change
The section can be easily re-enabled by changing a single configuration value or boolean flag

file_operations.description: Create a feature flags configuration file with a boolean flag ENABLE_ASK_AI_SECTION to control the visibility of the Ask AI section. Set the default value to false to hide the section.

Import the ENABLE_ASK_AI_SECTION flag from the features config. Wrap the AskAIModule component and its surrounding section with a conditional check that only renders when ENABLE_ASK_AI_SECTION is true. Ensure the conditional rendering does not affect the surrounding layout or other sections like quiz display, summaries, or file upload.
